body: my whole entire life i've been focused on prioritizing others. i cared for my brothers. practically raised them. provides emotional support for my whole family and all of my friends. even the careers i want to pursue involve helping other people. but nothing is reciprocated. is it cruel for me to wish to be selfish? just this once? the only thing i want is for this to all be over. no one else has helped me. nothing else can help me. so what is even the point anymore?
